goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy an upgrade there, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The playtester got its plot by auto-claim, bought Dropper 2, Speed 1 and Dropper 3 from the pads, opened the SHOP and bought Silver Ore, then bought Cash x1.5 from its pad. It never went to or looked at the TOP TYCOONS board, so that part of the goal was not tested. Most later SHOP Buy clicks (Cash x1.5, Gold Ore) did not fire even when affordable, and the rest of the session went on rebirth tests.

bugs.title: SHOP 'Buy' buttons for Cash x1.5 and Gold Ore do not fire despite enough cash
bugs.evidence: Steps 8, 9 and 11: Card_mult1.State ('Buy', $300) and Card_tier_gold.State clicked with cash 368-908, each result 'button did NOT fire'. Steps 14 and 16 repeated the failure on Gold ('changed: nothing on screen'). The shop_purchases counter stayed at 1 (only Silver Ore at step 4). Cash x1.5 only worked via its world pad at step 12/13. A player cannot buy these items from the SHOP. The button may be offset or covered by another UI element.

bugs.title: Failed SHOP purchase gives no feedback
bugs.evidence: Steps 8-16: failed Buy clicks changed nothing on screen except the cash tick. There was no error text, no 'not enough' message and no sound. The card still read 'Buy'.

bugs.title: Tutorial text reverts to 'Walk to the CLAIM gate!' after the plot is claimed
bugs.evidence: Step 7 and later: TutorialText changed from 'Step on the glowing green pad!' back to 'Walk to the CLAIM gate!' with the plot already claimed and 2 droppers running. The tutorial_reshown counter climbed to 70 in the probe. This is confusing for new players.

bugs.title: Owned pads still show buy label and price
bugs.evidence: After dropper_bought rose and the shop showed 'Owned', the touchables still listed 'Dropper 2 | $10 | Step here! $10' (steps 2-3) and 'Speed 1 | $22' (step 3). The HUD showed a stale '$10'.

bugs.title: Rebirth denied with no stated requirement
bugs.evidence: The REBIRTH $5000 button and the altar prompt both gave 'Not ready to rebirth' (rebirth_denied=6) at cash 1.3-1.4K, with no explanation of what is needed. TotalEarned was about 2e12, so the rule behind 'Not ready' is unclear.

bugs.title: Absurd income and TotalEarned values for a new player
bugs.evidence: Step 1: the HUD shows '+$200B/s' with cash 110. Steps 2-4: TotalEarned goes from 1999999999980 to 1999999999990. This is likely a test seed, but it makes the income display and any earnings-based logic or leaderboard unreliable.
